sop_modules.name: Protect Space & Contain Work Area
sop_modules.purpose: Protect floors, adjacent finishes, and furnishings; set containment appropriate to environment and method.

sop_modules.name: Hardware Handling
sop_modules.purpose: Remove/reinstall or mask hardware based on selected approach.

sop_modules.name: Clean, Degloss & Prep Surface
sop_modules.purpose: Remove contaminants, degloss, and prep for adhesion; method varies by door type and condition.

sop_modules.name: Hand Sand Profiles & Burn Edges
sop_modules.purpose: Hand sand routed profiles and slightly break sharp edges to reduce beading and improve adhesion.

sop_modules.name: French Door Glass Protection
sop_modules.purpose: Protect glass lites via masking or controlled cut-in strategy.

sop_modules.name: Patch/Repair & Spot Prime
sop_modules.purpose: Perform minor repairs, feather edges, and spot prime risk zones or patches.

sop_modules.name: Apply Finish Coats
sop_modules.purpose: Apply finish coats with method-specific controls and quality discipline.

sop_modules.name: Inspect & Correct Defects
sop_modules.purpose: Inspect, correct defects, and repeat as quality level requires.

tasks.name: Protect floor and adjacent area
tasks.notes: Increase protection intensity when spraying and/or in occupied spaces.

tasks.name: Set containment (if spraying/occupied)
tasks.notes: Optional for brush/roll in vacant spaces; recommended for spray in occupied spaces.

tasks.name: Remove hardware (as selected)
tasks.notes: If remove/reinstall chosen, label hardware per opening.

tasks.name: Mask hardware (as selected)
tasks.notes: Masking saves removal time but risks paint lines and callbacks.

tasks.name: Clean surface (remove oils/contamination)
tasks.notes: Required for all door types; intensity varies by contamination.

tasks.name: Degloss / sand for adhesion
tasks.notes: Slab doors may allow power sanding on flats; detailed doors require hand work on profiles.

tasks.name: Hand sand profiles and routed areas
tasks.notes: Panel/French/louvered: required to avoid missed gloss and promote adhesion.

tasks.name: Burn/soften sharp edges to prevent beading
tasks.notes: Slight break only; preserve crisp look while reducing beading.

tasks.name: Mask glass lites
tasks.notes: More reliable and typically required for spray; slower than cut-in.

tasks.name: Cut-in at glass edges (no masking)
tasks.notes: High-skill method; client acceptance and risk tolerance vary.

tasks.name: Minor repairs and patching
tasks.notes: For dents, nail holes, edge dings. Major repairs excluded.

tasks.name: Spot prime repairs / burn-through / adhesion risk zones
tasks.notes: Use bonding primer where required; do not blanket-prime unless conditions demand.

tasks.name: Apply finish coat 1
tasks.notes: Method-specific controls; maintain edge discipline and avoid heavy buildup on louvers.

tasks.name: Sand between coats (quality-driven)
tasks.notes: Commonly required at QL-4/QL-5, selective at QL-3 depending on defects.

tasks.name: Apply finish coat 2
tasks.notes: Final coat discipline; QL-5 may include optional clear coat stage in materials system.

tasks.name: Inspection pass 1
tasks.notes: At QL-3, typically one inspection pass plus corrections.

tasks.name: Correct defects (runs, holidays, nibs)
tasks.notes: Louvers and French doors have higher correction risk.

assumptions: Tasks are modular building blocks; applicability is controlled via spec variants and module applies_to filters.
Not all tasks apply to every configuration (e.g., glass protection only for French doors).
exclusions: Major carpentry repairs or door replacement workflows are not included in this SOP library.
